queries: Sightline Climate February 2026 190 GW data center pipeline demand defaults
AI data center SPV default insolvency 2026 October demand shortfall

sources_considered.why: Primary project-tracking source underlying the cited buildout. Its pipeline measurement does not establish a paying-demand shortfall.
A dated secondary compilation provides context for checking whether widespread collapse had already been documented. Its coverage is not a complete census.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph beginning the quantitative pipeline discussion

receipt.public_excerpt: We’re tracking 190GW across 777 large data centers and AI factories (>50MW) announced since 2024.

evidence_items.explanation: This establishes the scope of the announced pipeline cited in the post. Announced electrical capacity does not establish realized paying demand or show that the forecast's condition has occurred.

evidence_items.locator: GPU default questions, answer to 'Which GPU companies have defaulted?'

receipt.public_excerpt: No neocloud has publicly defaulted on a GPU-backed loan as of October 2026.

evidence_items.explanation: The compilation does not identify the forecast's widespread collapse. Its negative finding is limited to public GPU-backed loan defaults and cannot disprove an open-ended forecast.

unresolved_gaps: The demand-shortfall antecedent has not been established using comparable demand and required-revenue measurements.
No defined cohort and comprehensive failure record establish an overwhelming majority of collapses.
The forecast supplies no deadline or duration for the demand condition.
The default compilation is secondary and does not cover every project or financing vehicle.
